base: branche de session (EWC1 et ESN1 pour les utilitaires) ; aucun emprunt aux branches soeurs
biome: fin de donjon de la clairiere tropicale (arene au centre, tertre sacre au nord), choisie par l agent ; serie des fins, dans l ordre du mod apres FST1
method: textures canoniques = rendu genere REFERENCE : rip passe au generateur ; decor complet mer en magenta, herbe complete et temoin sans objets edites depuis le decor, planche papillons sur magenta

reference_da.titre: Clairiere tropicale et rive (titre de l audit zones_bg_audit_v1 ; jeu et scene non confirmes)

generation.prompt: Use EXACTLY the same textures, palette and pixel-art style as the reference image (Pokemon Mystery Dungeon tropical clearing): same soft muted light yellow-green grass with fine blade texture, same dark green dense jungle bushes with leafy outlines, same coconut palm trees, same red, yellow, cyan and pink hibiscus flower clusters, same tan sandy stepping-stone slabs, same small grey pebbles, same brown earth bank cliff edge. Make a NEW, larger top-down map. WIDE LANDSCAPE 4:3, zoomed out so the area feels vast. Layout of a DUNGEON END arena: along the SOUTH edge a band of sea; a long wooden plank jetty starts at the bottom edge center and crosses the sea north to the brown earth bank. From the jetty a trail of tan stepping-stone slabs winds NORTH into a very large wide open round grass clearing in the CENTER (a boss arena, wide empty floor). At the NORTH (top center) a sacred mound of tan-brown earth and rock overgrown with jungle bushes and flower clusters, with a flat sandy slab platform at its foot; the stepping stones lead right up to that platform, dry. Dense jungle fills the left, right and top edges, completely closing the clearing. IMPORTANT: the whole sea surface is filled with flat pure magenta #FF00FF, no waves, no foam, no white lines. No characters, no signpost, no text, no UI, no border.
generation.essais: premier essai, conforme : arene centrale vide, plateforme de sable au pied du tertre, aucun trou sombre

generation.prompt: Same image, same framing and pixel-art style, but only the plain light yellow-green clearing grass with its fine blade texture everywhere, covering the whole image, nothing else. Keep the ochre grass strokes and texture, no acid yellow. No objects, no text, no border.

Remove every palm tree, every flower cluster, every small bush tuft and every small grey pebble: replace them with what is around them (the same dense dark green jungle bushes, or the same light grass in the clearing). Keep the sacred earth mound at the north, its flat sandy slab platform, the stepping stones, the earth bank, the wooden jetty and the flat magenta sea exactly as they are. No text, no border.

access.rule: case bloquee si > 25 % hors praticable (herbe, ombres, dalles, seuil, touffes reliees, ponton)

access.boss: case 2 x 2 libre la plus proche du centre de gravite du praticable (centre de l arene)
